title: Rockefeller's panel meets at Quantico

tellings.quote: The group first met at Quantico, Virginia to draft reports for Eisenhower.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 1955 a group led by Nelson Rockefeller, a powerful political figure, first met at Quantico, a military base in Virginia, to draft reports for President Eisenhower. Michels tells it in an episode asking whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a programme to recover crashed unidentified craft, so the meeting would be an early link in that chain if true.
